proposed_value: DNA libraries were prepared by cloning 1,000 enhancer and 1,000 promoter sequences in all pairwise combinations into plasmids, followed by transfection into K562 cells. Plasmid pools were then used to generate STARR-seq RNA and input DNA libraries, which were sequenced to a depth of at least 2.6 billion reads for RNA and 470 million reads for DNA (Extended Data Fig. 1c). The DNA library was derived from input plasmid DNA prior to transcription, serving as a control for plasmid representation.
rationale:
- DNA libraries were prepared from input plasmid DNA prior to transcription, used as a control for plasmid representation in STARR-seq.
- The library was generated from a pool of 1,000 enhancer and 1,000 promoter sequences cloned in all pairwise combinations.
- Sequencing depth for DNA library reached at least 470 million reads (Extended Data Fig. 1c).
